subject: general
question: The series of articles titled ‘New Lamps for Old’, strongly criticising the Congress for its moderate policy towards British rule, was authored by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sri Aurobindo.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• 'New Lamps For Old ' (1893) was written by Aurbindo Ghosh in 'Indu - Prakash', a Bombay daily newspaper.
 
• Aurobindo Ghosh is also known as the Father of Indian Extremism.
 
• K. G. Deshpande, a friend from his Cambridge days, was in charge of a weekly published from Bombay called **Induprakash.**
 
• K. G. Deshpande requested Sri Aurobindo to write something on the current political situation of India.
 
• Sri Aurobindo began writing a series of fiery articles titled 'New Lamps for Old', strongly criticizing the Congress, then the main political party in India, for its moderate policy.
